_: From GT New Horizons' census (W4 R3 run, T13 judged, T14 corrected, 2026-11-09). Falling Obsidian, value 0 as the census saw it, is hard natural rock of the End; obsidian is on the decorative list so that made blocks stay out, which left this one out with them.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.7.10 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
